name: docmost-knowledge
description: Search, maintain, cite, and use templates in one or more private Docmost knowledge bases through Keychain-authenticated MCP connections.

interface.shortDescription: Use a private Docmost knowledge base safely from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Docmost Knowledge gives Codex permission-aware directory-scoped search, page editing, AI-oriented template, version history, attachment, and vector-index workflows across personal or company profiles. A local stdio proxy reads bearer tokens from macOS Keychain and forwards requests only over HTTPS without storing credentials in the plugin.
defaultPrompt: Search my Docmost knowledge base before answering.
Save these notes to the appropriate Docmost space.
Create this Docmost page with the best matching published template.
